h1: Upgrades, downgrades and cancellations, handled cleanly
overview: Changing plans should feel simple for the customer and predictable for you. We set up upgrades that take effect immediately with fair proration, downgrades that start at the end of the period, and cancellations that keep access until the paid time runs out. Each change shows a price preview before the customer confirms and sends a clear confirmation email, so there are fewer billing disputes.

faq: What is proration in plain words?
If a customer upgrades halfway through the month, they pay only the difference for the days left. Downgrades can give a credit. We choose a rule with you and show it to customers.
Can customers downgrade to a plan with fewer limits than they use?
We handle it. The app warns them what will be limited, and you decide whether to block the change or let them continue with softer limits.
Can I offer refunds when a customer cancels?
We can set up the flow, but refunds follow your own policy and your provider's rules. By default we do not refund automatically. We discuss what you want first.
Do you handle annual plans too?
Yes. Annual plans can upgrade immediately and cancel at the end of the year. We test the monthly-to-yearly switch, where proration is most often confusing.
